WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.subcategory, p.category, p.sku
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT 'all_lines' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d1, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, sum(quantity) q, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) staffq, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos FROM l
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cleaning', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), sum(quantity), sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END), sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM l WHERE subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND category='Cleaning & Household'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ctrl_units', 0, 0, 0, (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'), NULL, NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all_units_ex_test', 0,0,0,(SELECT sum(quantity) FROM l WHERE category<>'ZZ Test'),NULL,NULL

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.etl_loaded_at, cp.category, cp.subcategory
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products')
SELECT 'asis_units' k, count(*) n, sum(quantity) q, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT sale_date) days, max(etl_loaded_at) ld FROM l
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_units', count(*), sum(r.quantity_returned), min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date), NULL, NULL
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN l ON l.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_booked_in_period_store107', count(*), sum(r.quantity_returned), min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date), NULL, NULL
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND p.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, coalesce(r.receipts,0) receipts, coalesce(r.units_sold,0) units, (SELECT count(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales x WHERE x.business_date=d.calendar_date AND x.receipts>0 AND x.store_id<900) stores_trading
